cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Named for Arapai, Soroti District, Uganda (first demo site with severe connectivity limits). On-device LLM tutoring with FAISS RAG over local PDFs, CBC scenario assessment, and a safe numeric math engine — AI schools can own, run, and trust offline.

test_prompts.prompt: A student connects a thin, long wire in a circuit and notices the bulb is dimmer than when using a short, thick wire. Explain why this happens.
What is (48 / 6) + 7 * 2? Then explain in one sentence what order of operations means.
